caption: RDP Activity
description: Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP) Activity events report post-authentication remote client connections between clients and servers over the network.
name: rdp_activity

certificate_chain.description: The list of observed certificates in an RDP TLS connection.

connection_info.description: The remote desktop connection details, either connection-based or connectionless.

device.description: The device instigating the RDP connection.

file.description: The file that is the target of the RDP activity.

request.description: The client request in an RDP network connection.

response.description: The server response in an RDP network connection.

security_protocol.description: The security protocol that the server selected for the RDP connection, normalized to the caption of the security_protocol_id value. In the case of 'Other', it is defined by the event source.

security_protocol_id.description: The normalized identifier of the security protocol that the server selected for the RDP connection, as reported in the selectedProtocol field of the RDP Negotiation Response. It tells whether the user was authenticated before the remote session was set up, which is what Network Level Authentication requires.

1.caption: Standard RDP Security
1.description: Standard RDP Security, which uses the encryption built into RDP. Neither TLS nor CredSSP is used, and the user is not authenticated until after the remote session is set up.

2.caption: TLS
2.description: TLS protects the connection, but the user is not authenticated until after the remote session is set up.

3.caption: CredSSP
3.description: The Credential Security Support Provider (CredSSP) protocol over TLS, which authenticates the user before the remote session is set up. This is the protocol that Network Level Authentication uses.

4.caption: RDSTLS
4.description: The RDSTLS protocol, in which the client authenticates over TLS with credentials it received earlier from the server, for example in a redirection.

5.caption: CredSSP with Early User Authorization
5.description: CredSSP coupled with the Early User Authorization Result PDU, in which the server also tells the client whether the authenticated user is allowed to connect before the remote session is set up.

6.caption: RDS-AAD-Auth
6.description: RDS-AAD-Auth Security, in which the client authenticates with a token from a cloud identity provider.

99.caption: Other
99.description: The security protocol is not mapped. See the security_protocol attribute, which contains a data source specific value.

user.description: The target user associated with the RDP activity.
